what: Cells of evenly scattered round face icons all close into circles together every 5 seconds (.3s), then reopen with a different face and a different panel color (white · ink · accent, mixed in turn). Cells within 400px of the cursor grow the closer they are, reaching 3.5x right under it (in place, with no follow delay). It pauses when the panel is off screen.

options.every: Face swap interval (seconds), default 5 — the original base panel uses 3
options.close: Time to close and open as a circle (sec), default .3
options.grow: Share that grows larger right above, default 2.5(=3.5x). 0 means no cursor response

note: Cell layout (grid, gap, empty cells) is decided by the consuming css. Faces are clones of the pool’s children placed in each cell, and without a pool only the panel color changes. Cursor magnification is not applied on touch devices.

from.where: recruit.js .e-icons (original ENTRY BP·GP: KV board 8 columns · one row per 181px of screen height, 5s cycle · within 400px of the cursor 1+2.5×closeness / bottom board 5×4 · 3s cycle, 31 faces and three board colors shuffled in turn)
